mentions.name: MathBreakers
mentions.description: A math game sandbox/platform rebuilt on Node/PlayCanvas as a full 3D game engine with unique math-based primitives and a triggers/cinematic system similar to Unreal's. Gameplay makes math joyful: prime numbers come to life with personalities, and players battle and puzzle-solve across varied landscapes to bridge the spirit world and rescue a portaled friend.
mentions.source_excerpt: We're (re) building MathBreakers.com, a math game sandbox/platform. It's built on Node/PlayCanvas and is a full 3D game engine including our unique math-based primitives and triggers/cinematic system (similar to Unreal's).
mentions.author: ccvannorman
